# Publications

My research publications focus on palynology,
paleoecology, vegetation history, Holocene
environmental change, and human impacts on
ecosystems in East and Southeast Asia.

For a complete and updated publication list,
please visit my [Google Scholar profile](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=rMweiAkAAAAJ&hl=en).
